content:
- Ran bash .ralph/task_switch.sh after pushing; it completed task bookkeeping and email notification but emitted an rm error for missing .ralph/current_task.txt.
- Created bug task .ralph/tasks/bugs/task-switch-missing-current-task-file.md to track that script defect, per repo instructions to log surfaced bugs immediately.
- Repo is now dirty only from post-push .ralph bookkeeping plus the new bug file; next context should decide whether to commit those follow-up task-management changes separately.

- Read prior Ralph progress and confirmed the previous run already logged a task-switch bug after push.
- Loaded the improve-code-boundaries skill and checked repo status; only existing dirty files are Ralph bookkeeping plus the new task-switch bug file.
- Next I need to inspect the skill's found_smells queue and choose one concrete boundary cleanup in src/ or tests/.

- Chose smell 10 in src/cli/config.rs: tiny private conversion helpers around resolve_operator_context look like fake boundaries.
- Read Makefile to confirm make check == lint and to avoid forbidden cargo test usage.
- I botched the first proof rename by renaming the callsites too; next I am correcting that so the compiler shows the actual helper caller count.

- Inlined the single-caller optional_token_source helper into resolve_operator_context in src/cli/config.rs and removed the helper; make check passed.
- make lint passed.
- make test failed before executing tests: cargo/nextest reported a missing object file while building target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/debug/deps/libpgtuskmaster_rust-*.rlib. Next I need to determine whether this is stale build state or a real reproducible project regression.

- Applied improve-code-boundaries smell 10 in src/cli/config.rs by proving optional_token_source had a single owner via temporary rename and make check, then inlining it into resolve_operator_context and deleting the helper.
- make lint passed. make test initially failed because stale aarch64 target artifacts left cargo unable to open an object while building the rlib; a targeted cargo clean for pgtuskmaster_rust and pgtuskmaster_test_support fixed the build cache issue, after which make test passed with 243 tests green.
- Next after this context should be nothing for this task if push and task switch succeed; otherwise inspect push/task-switch output, especially whether the known current_task.txt rm bug recurs.
